svg.title: My work: everything assigned to me, across every team — SoftTrack web design mockup (#258)
svg.desc: Signing in lands on the board of the first team you are on, so somebody on three teams opens three boards to learn what to do today. A page of one’s own lists what is assigned across teams with what is late pulled to the top, with tabs for watching and created by me, and a column for what is waiting on a decision.
svg.text: My work: everything assigned to me, across every team
· what should I do today, answered in one place

svg.text: Done when /my-work lists open tickets assigned to the viewer across their teams, in flight first, grouped by team or as one list; due soon and overdue are pulled to the top;
Watching and Created by me are tabs; Waiting on me holds invitations; the page works with no team; and it is in the sidebar, the command palette and on a shortcut. GET

g.text: Pulled to the top whatever the grouping
what is late, and what is due in the next
Totals come from the database, per team,
the way the workload tab counts. The page
This is the page #318 asks for. It needs no board to hang on.
In flight first, then by due date and priority. The team’s key says
The tickets you watch, with what last happened on each.
Watching decides who is notified; this is where it is seen.
